current.text: Indiana took him with the 38th pick, through a draft-night trade with the Bulls.
His contract is not settled yet. He will stay with the team on either a minimum deal or a two-way contract.
He is behind T.J. McConnell at backup guard. He is not in the projected bench rotation of Oubre, Toppin, Huff, McConnell and Jarace Walker.
In Summer League he averaged 7 assists but only 6 points in 27 minutes. He had low usage and shot poorly.
In dynasty rookie rankings for the 2026 draft class he is rank 43, tier 7.

durable.text: He is one of the best passers in his draft class.
He is undersized for an NBA guard.
Scoring is his weak point. He plays on low usage and his shooting is poor.

note: Braden Smith (IND, G) is not a draft option for us. Yahoo values him at 0 USD and ranks him 602nd.
